articles.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
articles.summary: Itaú is revolutionizing customer engagement in Brazil's highly regulated banking sector by implementing ia.i, a generative AI conversational interface, alongside the IARA governance platform, showcasing a bold AI First strategy that enhances service delivery for both customers and employees. This breakthrough not only streamlines operations but also sets a new standard for innovation in financial services.

articles.title: ASML eyes hybrid bonding, report finds, as Chinese firms adopt chip packaging technique
articles.summary: ASML's foray into hybrid bonding technology, which enables ultra-dense electrical connections by directly fusing chips or silicon wafers, marks a significant advancement in semiconductor manufacturing, while its adoption by major Chinese firms underscores a pivotal shift towards enhanced chip performance in the global market. This breakthrough not only positions ASML at the forefront of innovation but also highlights the escalating competition in the semiconductor landscape.

articles.title: How to be a (Roman) man
articles.summary:
• Cicero redefined masculinity by emphasizing self-control and bravery over arrogance and aggression.  
• The Roman ideal of manhood advocates for moral integrity and the pursuit of virtue in personal conduct.  
• True strength lies in the ability to govern oneself rather than exert power over others.  
• The essence of manliness is found in humility and the service of the greater good, rather than in personal glory.  
• Reflecting on Cicero's ideals challenges contemporary notions of masculinity and invites a deeper exploration of virtue.

articles.title: China’s AI boom, self-sufficiency push fuel earnings surge for local chip firms
articles.summary: China's chip firms are experiencing an unprecedented surge in profits, with some reporting up to six-fold increases, driven by soaring demand for domestic processors and AI infrastructure as the country intensifies its self-sufficiency efforts. This remarkable growth underscores a pivotal shift in the global tech landscape, positioning China as a formidable player in the semiconductor industry.
